description: Fires on the move where the opening tree first matches (≥3 setup steps). The {opening_summary} comes from data/opening_curriculum.json — adding a new opening = adding a JSON entry there, no edits here. Overrides generic narration of the move itself ('Opponent develops the bishop to c4') with the named opening + its teaching summary.

fact_glossary.move_san: SAN of the move that completed the opening pattern
fact_glossary.opening_name: Authored opening name from data/opening_curriculum.json (e.g. 'Italian Game')
fact_glossary.opening_summary: Authored opening summary / golden rules from data/opening_curriculum.json
